$comment: Maturity classification per required component. Documentation-only. Classifications: PRODUCTION_SHAPED, IMPLEMENTED, PARTIAL_PROTOTYPE, SHADOW_ONLY, SIMULATED, DOCUMENTED_ONLY, PLANNED, MISSING.

GovernanceContracts.evidence: 45 tests pass; three neutral families frozen; leaf stdlib-only

TAP.evidence: tap_provider adapter 38 tests pass; truth_assurance_pipeline E1-E5 deterministic on synthetic data; E6/E7 docs-only; no real-model evidence at scale

DecisionAuthority.evidence: 79 tests pass; frozen kernel; DecisionRecord/CER/ActionRequest/Override/ExecutionIntent; repositories are in-memory ports (no durable DB)

ActionGate.evidence: actiongate_provider 30 tests pass; ACTION_GOVERNANCE adapter; shadow-validated against fixtures

ACP.evidence: design-first; never enforcing; robotics/K8s/db domains only; NO GitHub domain; ClearanceVerdict CLEAR/HOLD; no durable clearance ref

StoryGraph.evidence: 316 tests pass; advisory OBSERVE/ESCALATE/UNAVAILABLE only; own tenant-isolated provider registry; real durable_audit SQLite store

EvidenceSubsystem.evidence: content-hash + source provenance present; NO durable evidence store (proven absent); no validator-identity binding; no quarantine/admissibility; no head-SHA invalidation; research code

DurableAuditStore.evidence: REAL hash-chained SQLite stores in StoryGraph durable_audit.py and agentic/ledger/governance_audit_store.py (reference-grade); decision kernel audit is in-memory with previous_event_hash RESERVED (unused); no unified cross-capability audit backend

WorkflowInfrastructure.evidence: no durable workflow engine as code; agent_runtime_v2 docs-only; agent_runtime_migration in-memory (no persistence/resume/event-sourcing/webhook); control_plane single-request mock orchestration

GitHubEvidenceConnector.evidence: no GitHub ingestion code; net-new product connector

GitHubExecutionProvider.evidence: no EXTERNAL_EXECUTION GitHub provider; only framework DeterministicExecutionProvider test-double exists

RepositoryPolicyEngine.evidence: POLICY_PACK_GOVERNED_WORKFLOW_COMPILER_SPEC.md exists; StoryGraph policypack compiler is real but domain-specific; no code-governance repo-policy engine

IdentityIntegration.evidence: DA ActorIdentity/ActorType + authenticate(); no enterprise OIDC/SSO; no GitHub identity mapping; SoD off by default

CodeGovernanceUI.evidence: ACP/UGENCE_UNIFIED_CONSOLE_PLAN.md; no code-governance PR check-run UI

CompetitiveCodeAdjudication.evidence: no patch-pair adjudication capability; reusable analogues only (model-selection Selection contract, comparative_governance_benchmark harness, StoryVerdict, reviewer_ready_pilot AdjudicationResult)

DeploymentGovernance.evidence: MVP3; reuses ACP+ActionGate K8s surface (shadow); no build provenance/digest binding implemented
